content_html:
Voice input and an AI agent in your Mac's notch.
Bring your own keys. No account, no servers, no telemetry.

Download · Website & help · Docs

Features

  • Drop: hold Space in any text field, speak, release, and the text is pasted at the cursor. Fast pastes the transcript; Smart lightly edits it with your model.
  • Agent: tap Right ⌘ to type a question or hold it to speak. It reads files, searches the web and answers in the island.
  • Meeting Assistant (Beta): get help answering questions during a call using your project's files. Configure its models and select a Space, then enable listening with the wand for each meeting, or type a question. Listening starts off. Attach screenshots for visual context. Setup.
  • Meeting notes: notices calls in Zoom, Teams, Slack and Google Meet and turns them into a summary with a transcript.
  • History: your clipboard, dictations and agent answers in one list, ready to paste again.
  • Case: a secrets vault for Claude Code, Cursor and Whytap Agent. Agents see key names; Case puts the value into the command they run.
  • Shot: a screenshot editor with arrows, text blur and Copy text.
  • Display Extra: brighter whites on XDR and HDR displays, beyond the usual maximum.
  • Notify: notifications from any script your coding agent writes, next to the island.

Also in the island: Translate and live Subtitles, Vocab, To-do, Calendar and Monitor dashboards.

Your keys, your Mac

  • Use your own keys for Soniox, Deepgram, ElevenLabs, OpenRouter, OpenAI or Anthropic, or your own OpenAI-compatible server. Keys stay in the macOS Keychain.
  • Audio and text go only to the provider you chose for that feature. There is no Whytap account, backend or telemetry.
  • Free and open source under the MIT license.

What leaves your Mac, and when: Privacy.

Install

macOS 14.2 or newer, Apple Silicon and Intel. Signed and notarized; updates arrive in the island. More in Install and update.

Quick start

  1. Open Whytap. Hover the island at the top of the screen and click Settings.
  2. In Permissions, allow Microphone and Accessibility. In API & Models, add a speech key and pick a model for Drop.
  3. Click into any text field, hold Space, speak and release.
Action Default
Dictate into the focused field hold Space
Ask the agent by text / by voice tap / hold Right ⌘
Google the selection / your voice tap / hold Right ⌥
Start or stop a meeting recording ⌥ M
Close the agent answer Esc

Remap any of them, or give any tool its own shortcut, in Settings → Hotkeys.

Help

Questions about setup, a feature or a problem with the app? Ask on whytap.ai, where you can find more information about Whytap.

Build from source

Needs Xcode 26 or newer (Swift 6).

git clone https://github.com/AbsoluteMode/whytap.git
cd whytap
swift test
./scripts/dev-run.sh --run

Build details · Customize Whytap with your coding agent

Contributing

Bug reports and pull requests are welcome; see CONTRIBUTING.md.

Security

Report vulnerabilities to niceizzy1337@gmail.com; see SECURITY.md.

License

MIT. The Whytap name and icon: TRADEMARK.md. Third-party code: THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md.
